messages:
Lina (CS): Quick flag from onboarding with Meridian Health — same three asks across finance, security, and mobile eng. Concerned this is a renewal signal. cc @Evan @Pri

Evan (Product): paste the asks + any verbatim lines pls. rough pri less ok.

Lina (CS): TL;DR: (1) In-console cost allocation by route/environment (exports only today). (2) Endpoint-level model lockdown/pinning for PHI flows. (3) Mobile SDK: resume + reconnect/backoff to avoid full session restarts on flaky networks.

Pri (PM): initial priors: 3 = quick reliability win (high ROI), 1 = medium effort (backend + UI), 2 = larger (RBAC + audit + security review).

Sam (AE): renewal 2025-10-08. Meridian procurement wants per-route chargeback before final approval — budget sensitive.

Lina (CS): short CSV snippet from notes with customer language:

Lina (CS): ```
customer,ask,impact,quote
Meridian,per_route_chargeback,finance needs line items,"We must show spend per workflow to allocate costs"
Meridian,endpoint_pinning,security needs control,"Can't allow experimental models on patient endpoints"
Meridian,mobile_resume,reliability for demos,"On weak LTE the stream restarts and we lose session state"
```

notify-bot: Auto-summary tags: [chargeback_ui, endpoint_pinning, sdk_reconnect]. Linked PROD-Triage-1402.

Pri (PM): I'll open PROD-Triage-1402 and propose priorities: sdk_reconnect -> P1, per_route_chargeback -> P2, endpoint_pinning -> P3. Will add estimates after scoping.

Evan (Product): add to roadmap sync and request a one-paragraph customer brief + invoice rows before we commit.

Lina (CS): Action items: Lina collect invoice rows + quotes; Pri open ticket; Evan review for legal/security if we scope variant controls. Sam to prep renewal note. Looping back with artifacts. :thumbsup:
